thinking_summary:
All the noise values are quite high, around 650-950 ADU, which points to the amplifier not performing well and gain being erratic. Configuration #4 looks best, with Vdd -21.7, Vdrain -10.9, Vr -7.1, and delay 12 — comparing against typical skipper/LTA values like Vdd ≈ -22, Vr ≈ -7, Vdrain somewhere around -14 to -19.

I'll try exploring near that #4 configuration with slight adjustments: Vdd -22.5, Vdrain -12, Vr -7.0, delay 12, and re-measure from there.

Configuration #4 is still my best result so far, with a close runner-up at #9, both favoring a region of very negative Vdd, moderate negative drain voltage, and low delay. I'm thinking about nudging the parameters slightly—trying a bit more negative Vdd with a less negative drain voltage to see if gain improves.

The best region so far is very negative Vdd with Vdrain near -10 and Vr around -7.2, giving low delay, with point 10 sitting at that corner. I'm comparing it against point 4's result and deciding to push Vr even more negative, maybe around -7.6 to -7.8, to see if delay improves further.

The best region so far is around Vdd -23, Vdrain -10, with low Vr (-7.7) and low delay, where gain improves as Vdd becomes more negative and Vdrain less negative. I'm considering pushing Vr further to -8 or adjusting delay, and also testing a slightly more negative Vdrain like -11 at Vdd -23 to see how gain responds.

The best region so far is Vdd -23, Vdrain -10, Vr -7.7 with delay 10; comparing nearby points (-21.7,-10.9 giving 0.70 and -22.3,-12.5 giving 1.09) suggests this corner is favorable, so I'll try Vr -8.0 with delay 10 next.

The best result so far is at Vdd=-23, Vdrain=-10, Vr=-7.7 with delay 10, though nearby points show the noise is significant—Vr=-8 performed worse and Vr=-7.3 at delay 11 was also weaker. I'm thinking about exploring Vr near -7.5 at delay 10, or pushing Vdrain slightly past the current bound to around -11, given that a nearby point with Vdrain=-10.9 and Vdd=-21.7 yielded nothing.

The best region seems to be around Vdd -23, Vdrain -10 to -11.5, Vr about -7.6 to -7.7, with delay 10, though the noise std of 650-730 ADU looks too large to be real read noise, suggesting gain is the dominant factor here. Gain appears larger near Vr -7.3 to -7.7 with low delay, so I want to explore Vdrain around -13 and check point 9 with Vdrain -12.5, Vdd -22.3, Vr -7.

Since delays below 10 aren't allowed, I'll probe Vr -7.4 at Vdrain -10.7, Vdd -23, delay 10 to see sensitivity between values, and also try Vdrain -13 at Vr -7.6 since Vdd -23 seems to be the best boundary value so far.

The best region seems to be around Vdd -23, Vdrain -10 to -13, Vr near -7.6/-7.7 with delay 10, so I'm considering nearby variations like Vr -7.4 or a slightly less negative Vdd around -22 with Vdrain -11, comparing against earlier data points to see if they might outperform the current best.

I notice Vdd being more negative seems to help, while Vdrain is fairly flat between -10 and -13, so I want to test an edge case further out, maybe Vdrain -14.5 or -15, pairing it with Vdd -23 and Vr -7.7 at delay 10 to check if that pushes performance higher.

The best region looks like Vdd=-23, Vr around -7.6/-7.7, delay 10, with Vdrain roughly flat between -10 and -15. I should explore further: pushing Vdrain to -18, adjusting Vr near -7.4, or nudging Vdd to -22, since -23 seems to be at the boundary and already performing best.

The best region seems to be Vdd around -23 with Vdrain -10 to -15 and Vr near -7.6/-7.7 at delay 10 — I've tried -7.3 (0.569 at delay 11), -7.7 (0.502), and -8.0 (0.634). I'm considering trying Vr -7.4 or -7.5 at delay 10, or easing Vdd to something like -22, with another data point at Vdd -21.7.

Got 0.70 with Vr -7.1 at delay 12. Now I'll try Vr -7.4 with Vdrain -12.5, Vdd -23, delay 10.

The best region seems to be Vdd around -23 with Vdrain -10 to -15 and Vr near -7.6/-7.7, hitting delay 10 right at the lower bound, with Vdd also pinned at its lower bound. I'm considering nudging Vdd slightly higher, maybe testing -22 with Vdrain -11.5 and Vr -7.6 at delay 10, or alternatively exploring Vr around -7.9 with Vdrain -13.

Other Vr variants gave lower gains: -8.0 at Vdrain -10 produced 0.634, and -7.3 gave 0.569 at delay 11. Given the noise in F is roughly ±0.03 and several points cluster around 0.50-0.53, I want to check whether the Vdd lower bound actually matters by trying Vdd -22.0 with Vdrain -13 and Vr -7.7 at delay 10 as a reasonable next exploration point.

The best region so far seems to be around Vdd -23, Vdrain -10 to -15, with Vr near -7.6 to -7.7, giving a delay of 10 and noise around 0.50-0.55 with some scatter. I'm still considering unexplored combinations, like Vdd -23 with Vdrain -11 and Vr -7.8, to see if that hits the same minimum delay.

The best region seems to be Vdd at -23 with drain voltage -10 to -15 and Vr around -7.6 to -7.7, giving delay at its floor of 10, though I should check if Vr near -7.0 at the same Vdd and delay has been tried yet.

Gain is clearly the dominant factor, peaking around Vdrain -10/-7.7 and -13/-7.6, with noise bouncing unpredictably between 610-780. I think Vdd near -23 is already optimal and further tweaking of Vdrain beyond -15 or -18 doesn't help since the falloff region looks settled, so I'll lock in Vdd -23, Vdrain -12, Vr -7.7, delay 10 as the center of the best region to re-confirm.

The best region so far seems to be around Vdd -23, Vdrain -10 to -15, Vr near -7.7, delay 10, giving F around 0.50-0.57 with noise around 0.03-0.05. I notice delay sits at its lower bound, and there's an unexplored gap around Vr -7.2 to -7.3 that's worth probing further.

Looking at comparison points: Vr -8.0 gave 0.634, Vr -7.8 gave 0.55, so -7.6/-7.7 seems optimal, and the Vdrain range of -10 to -15 appears fairly flat in response. I'll try Vdrain -14 with Vr -7.7 at delay 10 to fill the gap between -13 and -15.

The best region so far is around Vdd -23, Vdrain -10 to -15, Vr near -7.7, delay 10, giving noise scatter roughly 0.50-0.60. There's still unexplored territory around Vr -7.0 to -7.5 at delay 10 with Vdrain near -11.5, and possibly Vr -6.5 at delay 10 too, since delay 10 seems to be at a boundary worth pushing further.

The best region so far centers around Vdd=-23, Vdrain between -10 and -15, Vr around -7.6 to -7.7, with delay at 10, giving noise near 0.50-0.60 and low scatter. I still haven't explored Vr between -7.8 and -8 with Vdrain near -12, or slightly adjusted Vdd values of -21 to -22, and delay seems to be capped at its boundary of 10 — testing Vr -7.3 with delay 11 gave 0.569, while Vr -7.0 gave 0.69.

With 7 points remaining, I'm considering exploring Vdd=-22 slightly (which gave 0.56 at Vdrain -13), or replicating the best point to estimate noise variance between nearby configurations. I'll try Vr -7.9 with Vdrain -12 and delay 10 to probe just outside the current best cluster.

The best region seems to be around Vdd -23, Vdrain -10 to -15, with Vr near -7.6/-7.7 giving delay 10 and noise scatter roughly 0.50-0.60. With 6 trials left, I'm considering testing Vdd -22 (which gave 0.56) or trying Vr -7.5 untested at low Vdrain, since gain appears to peak near Vr -7.6/-7.7.

The best region is around Vdd -23, Vdrain -10 to -11.5, Vr -7.6/-7.7 with delay 10, giving the lowest value of 0.448 at -10.5/-7.6, though there's some noise scatter around 0.05. With only a few measurements left, I'm weighing whether to re-measure the best point or explore Vr -7.5 near Vdrain -10.5, especially since nearby values like -7.4 (0.545), -7.0 (0.69), and -7.9 (0.64) show the response degrading quickly away from this sweet spot.

The best region seems to be around Vdd -23, Vdrain -10 to -11.5, Vr -7.6 to -7.7, giving delay 10 with noise scatter near 0.05. With four measurements left, I'm weighing whether to explore Vr -7.5 at Vdrain -10.5 or re-measure point #25, since the Vr trend shows -7.0 performing worse at 0.69 while -7.4 through -7.7 cluster lower around 0.45-0.57.

Looking further out, -7.8 through -8.0 start climbing again, confirming the optimum sits near -7.6, with gain appearing strongest at Vdrain -10.5. I'll go ahead and try Vdrain -10.5 with Vr -7.5 to probe just outside the known sweet spot.

The best region so far centers around Vdd -23, Vdrain -10.5, Vr -7.5/-7.6, giving delay 10 with noise scatter around 0.05. With only three measurements left, I'm weighing whether to probe Vr -7.4 or -7.3 at Vdrain -10.5, or try Vdrain -10.0 with Vr -7.5, while keeping in mind earlier points like -12.5/-7.4 giving 0.545 and -7.0 giving 0.69.

Looking at the gain trend across Vr values (-7.7→1390, -7.6→1540, -7.5→1466), the signal looks noise-driven rather than a clean peak. I'll go with Vdrain -10.5, Vr -7.4 next to bracket the optimum.

My best result so far is 0.428 at Vdd -23, Vdrain -10.5, Vr -7.4. I'm noticing Vr around -7.4 to -7.6 performs well at Vdrain -10.5, while other nearby points with Vr -7.0 or different Vdrain values give worse scores. I should try adjusting Vr slightly to -7.3 while keeping Vdrain at -10.5 to see if it improves further.
For the final measurement, I'll go with the best predicted region: Vdd -23, Vdrain -10.5, Vr around -7.4, delay 10, since gain peaks near there.
